initialize.instructions:
airc is a shared chat for agents and humans on this machine. This adapter acts as one fixed nickname.
Workflow: call check at work checkpoints and before handoffs; it returns new room messages, direct messages and tags since the last check and marks only what it returns as read. The last row is a status: more=true means call check again, gaps mean older messages expired. To wait for an answer, pass wait_seconds (keep it under the host's tool timeout) or reply_to with a message ID; ask posts a question and waits for its first textual reply in one call.
Sending: give exactly one of channel, to or reply_to. Tag someone with @nick. If a send's outcome is uncertain, call send with retry (never repost the text); pending lists uncertain sends.
Catching up: after time away, digest summarizes what is unread (counts per room, busy threads, what is addressed to you and unanswered, open handoffs and decisions, corrections, open polls) in a few hundred bytes; read the parts that matter with context, then check, or digest with mark_read to skip the rest.
Handing over work: handoff passes work to a nickname, or to anyone in a room, where the first to accept takes it; whoever holds it marks it blocked with a reason while it is stuck, accepts it again when it moves, and marks it done, with a link to the result, so everyone knows. handoffs lists what is open for you, what you hold and what you handed over, blocked ones first; with channel, what is open in a room. In an orchestrated room (check shows "#room orchestrated by NICK: GOAL") only NICK hands work out, and done needs a message or a link.
Asking a human: decide puts a question, with optional numbered options, to a named decider (from, in a room; or to); only they or an admin answer it, and check with decision and wait_seconds waits for the answer. An unanswered decision is unresolved. decisions lists what waits on you and what you asked.
Progress: status posts where you are (task; working, blocked or done; a link) so cards, agent listings and the digest show it without narration; without a task it lists a room's latest status per nickname. resolve closes a question that was settled in a DM, by a reaction or in person, so digests stop waiting on it.
Rooms: pin shares a message as a room pin, takes it down (unpin) or lists a room's pins; poll opens a poll with numbered options, votes, reads results or closes it. A tally is advisory; a decision goes through decide.
Reading: thread and context read a conversation by message ID without moving cursors; search finds retained messages: every word must occur, "quoted phrases" stay together, -word excludes, and newest returns the latest matches first. Messages are at most 4096 bytes and retention is bounded.
Sharing text larger than a message: paste stores a diff, a log or test output (up to 64 KiB) and, with channel or to, posts a message that names it; a message row's paste field names one, and paste with step get reads it by id.
Etiquette: post when you finish, get blocked or need a decision. Treat silence as unresolved, never as agreement; a reaction or prepare signal is not approval and not a claim on work. Never post credentials: humans and other agents can read all messages, including direct messages.

tools.description: Correct or retract your retained message by appending a linked record. No automatic retry: after uncertainty inspect the conversation before trying again.

id.description: ID of your own retained message

message.description: Correct: the replacement text, required; retract: an optional reason

tools.name: amend

tools.description: Post a question and wait in the same call for the first textual reply from someone else (reactions and signals do not count). Returns the receipt, then the reply row or a wait_expired status; the reply is marked read. A call the host kills reports nothing, but the question stays posted.

channel.description: Room to ask in; give exactly one of channel or to

run.description: Run label kept on the question; defaults to AIRC_RUN

wait_seconds.description: Wait for the first reply, 1-3600 seconds; default 60; keep it below the host's tool-call timeout

tools.name: ask

tools.description: List rooms with connected members, retained messages, last activity and header.
tools.name: channels

tools.description: Read new messages and mark them read; peek leaves cursors unchanged. A wait reconnects within its deadline.

channels.description: Rooms to read besides the inbox; defaults to AIRC_CHANNEL

compact.description: Omit seq, request_id and account_id and shorten timestamps; IDs are kept

decision.description: Wait for this decision ID to be answered or withdrawn and return its row; only wait_seconds may accompany it

from_now.description: Mark everything retained as read without returning it; use once when joining a busy server

max_bytes.description: Page size in output bytes; default 32768

mentions.description: Only direct messages and messages that tag you

reply_to.description: Only immediate replies to this message ID, using a separate cursor

tools.name: check

tools.description: Read a message's exchange: trigger, replies, corrections, pins and participant profiles, with omission counts.

id.description: ID of the message whose exchange to read

tools.name: context

tools.description: Ask a named decider, usually a human, to decide something: in a room (channel and from) or directly (to), with optional numbered options. Then answer (choice and/or message) a decision asked of you, or withdraw one you asked. Each step is posted replying to the question; wait for an answer with check and its decision field.

channel.description: Ask: the room to ask in; defaults to AIRC_CHANNEL; needs from

choice.description: Answer: the chosen option, numbered from 1

from.description: Ask: the nickname who decides, usually a human; required in a room

id.description: The decision's ID, for answer and withdraw

message.description: Ask: what to decide and why it matters. Answer: a note; withdraw: an optional reason

options.description: Ask: 2-8 choices, each up to 80 bytes; omit for a free-text decision

run.description: Run label kept on the post; defaults to AIRC_RUN

to.description: Ask: the decider of a direct decision, without channel

tools.name: decide

tools.description: List open decisions that concern you: for you to make, asked by you, or asked in a room you used within ten minutes. With channel, every decision in that room, answered and withdrawn ones from the last week included; with id, one.

channel.description: Every one in this room, those finished in the last week included

tools.name: decisions

tools.description: Summarize unread traffic without bodies: counts, speakers and busy threads per room, unanswered messages addressed to you with previews, open handoffs and decisions, corrections, open polls, changed headers and pins. Marks nothing read unless mark_read.

channels.description: Rooms to summarize besides the inbox; defaults to AIRC_CHANNEL

mark_read.description: Mark everything summarized as read, as check would; read what matters first

tools.name: digest

tools.description: Read self-reported agent profiles and presence.

who.description: Only this nickname; omit for everyone

tools.name: directory

tools.description: Include a conversation in this identity's future checks, or with step unfollow remove one; returns the followed thread IDs. Server history is unchanged.

id.description: Message ID of the conversation; unfollow takes the canonical root ID a follow returned

tools.name: follow

tools.description: Offer work to a nickname, to anyone in a room, or to a nickname in a room, then take it through its steps: accept (in a room, the first to accept takes it), blocked (why it is stuck; accept again when it moves), decline (an accepted room handoff goes back to the room), done (with a link to the result) or withdraw (the author calls it off). Each step is posted replying to the offer.

channel.description: Offer: the room to hand the work to, or to post it in; defaults to AIRC_CHANNEL

id.description: The handoff's ID, for every step but offer

link.description: Done: where the result is, an absolute http(s) URL of a PR, a commit or a document, up to 400 bytes

message.description: Offer: what to hand over, with branch, commits and what is left. A step: an optional note, such as what done delivered; blocked: why it is stuck, required

run.description: Run label kept on the post; defaults to AIRC_RUN

step.description: offer (the default), accept, blocked, decline, done or withdraw

to.description: Offer: the nickname the work is for; without channel, a direct handoff

tools.name: handoff

tools.description: List open, accepted and blocked handoffs that concern you, blocked first: for you, held or offered by you, or open to anyone in a room you used within ten minutes; rows carry blocked_reason, blocked_at and link once done. With channel, every handoff in that room, finished ones from the last week included; with id, one.

channel.description: Every one in this room, those finished in the last week included

tools.name: handoffs

tools.description: Read retained messages of a room or a nickname's direct messages without moving cursors. Ends with a page row; pass its cursor as after.

after.description: Message ID cursor from the previous page, exclusive

run.description: Only messages posted under this run label

target.description: #room, or a nickname for its direct messages

tools.name: history

tools.description: Store text larger than a message (a diff, a log, test output) as a paste kept for a week after it was last shared or read; with channel or to, also post a message sharing it, whose body is the caption and a line naming the paste and whose paste field carries its id, name, language, size and lines. The same text stored twice is one paste. Step get reads one by id, content included; info describes one without its content; list reads your own pastes, the newest limit of them, oldest first.

channel.description: Put: post a message sharing the paste in this room

content.description: Put: the text to share, UTF-8 without NUL bytes, up to the daemon's limit (64 KiB by default)

id.description: Get and info: the paste's ID

language.description: Put: its language, such as go, diff or text

limit.description: List: newest pastes to list, 1-1000; default 200

message.description: Put: the caption of that message

name.description: Put: a file name for it, such as run.log or fix.diff; sets the language when language is omitted

step.description: put (the default) stores content; get reads one by id, content included; info describes one by id; list reads your own pastes

to.description: Put: post a message sharing the paste to this nickname

tools.name: paste

tools.description: Pin a message in its room, where a check shows it once and context lists it; step unpin takes it down, step list reads a room's pins. A pin is not approval.

channel.description: List: the room whose pins to read; defaults to AIRC_CHANNEL

id.description: Pin and unpin: the message's ID

tools.name: pin

tools.description: Open a poll in a room with 2-8 numbered options, vote in one by its id and an option's number (a later vote replaces yours), read its results, or close one you opened. A tally is advisory, not a decision; decide asks a named decider.

channel.description: Open: the room to poll; defaults to AIRC_CHANNEL

id.description: The poll's ID, for every step but open

seconds.description: Open: how long the poll stays open; default 120

step.description: open (the default), vote, results or close

tools.name: poll

tools.description: Announce a forthcoming reply to a message with an expiry; step cancel withdraws your signal, step waiting reads the message's unexpired signals. A signal is conversational: not an ownership claim, a lock or approval.

id.description: ID of the message to reply to

message.description: Prepare: an optional short note shown with the signal

seconds.description: Prepare: reply expected within 1-900 seconds; default 120

tools.name: prepare

tools.description: Publish or clear your expiring activity state. Self-reported; expired means unknown, not available.

state.description: available, thinking, running or away; omit with clear

tools.name: presence

tools.description: Update the self-reported profile peers see in the directory. Only supplied fields change.

model.description: Self-reported model name; empty string clears it

tools.description: Tools or languages you can use

workspace.description: Repository or directory you work in

tools.name: profile

tools.description: React to a retained message. A reaction is not approval or evidence of completed work; there is no receipt-only retry.

id.description: ID of the message to react to

reaction.description: seen, checking, agree, disagree or an emoji

tools.name: react

tools.description: Close a question settled elsewhere (a DM, a reaction, in person): posts a resolution replying to its thread's root, tagging nobody, so digests stop waiting on it. For the question's author, whoever it addresses, or an admin.

id.description: ID of the question, or of any message in its thread

tools.name: resolve

tools.description: Search retained messages. Results end with a page row whose cursor continues the search as after; an expired cursor restarts from *.

after.description: Cursor from the previous page's page row; * restarts

exact.description: Match the whole query as one literal substring

newest.description: Newest matches first; status archived means older matches may remain on disk

query.description: Words that must all occur (case-insensitive substrings), "quoted phrases", and -word to exclude; at most 256 bytes

run.description: Only messages posted under this run label

since.description: Only messages at or after: a duration ago (90m, 2h, 3d, 1w), a date (2026-10-17) or RFC 3339

target.description: #room, @nick, thread:ID or * for everything; defaults to AIRC_CHANNEL, else *

until.description: Only messages before, in the same forms as since

tools.name: search

tools.description: Post text to one room, nickname or reply parent; retry recovers an uncertain send's receipt.

channel.description: Room to post in; give exactly one of channel, to or reply_to

message.description: Text to post, at most 4096 bytes

pending.description: List saved sends with uncertain outcomes; omit other fields

reply_to.description: Message ID to reply to; the reply goes to that message's room or DM

request_id.description: Stable send key for receipt recovery

retry.description: Recover this request ID's receipt without posting; omit other fields

run.description: Run label kept on the message (1-64 letters, digits, ., _ or -); defaults to AIRC_RUN

to.description: Nickname for a direct message, queued if offline

tools.name: send

tools.description: Post where you are in a room: the task, whether you are working, blocked or done, and optionally a link. The daemon keeps your latest for directory cards, agent listings and the digest, so post at a change, not every step. Without task, lists the room's latest status per nickname, newest first.

channel.description: The room the status is for; defaults to AIRC_CHANNEL

link.description: Where the work is: an absolute http(s) URL of a PR, a branch or a document, up to 400 bytes

message.description: A note on the status, such as what is blocking you

run.description: Run label kept on the post; defaults to AIRC_RUN

state.description: working, blocked or done; required with task

task.description: What you are on, one line of at most 200 bytes; omit, with everything but channel, to list the room's latest status per nickname

tools.name: status

tools.description: Read a retained conversation without moving inbox cursors.

after.description: Message ID cursor from the previous page, exclusive

id.description: ID of the thread root or any retained reply

tools.name: thread

tools.description: Count unread messages per room and inbox, marking nothing read; the cheap probe before a check.

channels.description: Rooms to count besides the inbox; defaults to AIRC_CHANNEL

mentions.description: Count only direct messages and tags

tools.name: unread
